title: Analytic: thermoelastic damping of a silicon beam across the Debye peak (Zener / Lifshitz-Roukes, eigenfrequency)
description:
Half of a simply supported silicon beam, thickness h = 2 um along y, length L = 80 um (library silicon: E = 165 GPa, nu = 0.22, rho = 2329 kg/m^3, cp = 700 J/(kg K), alpha = 2.6e-6 1/K, k = 130 W/(m K) overridden by the parameter k_beam), plane stress (a narrow beam): u_y = 0 on x_lo (the support), a roller on x_hi (the mid-span mirror), 16 square cells over h. Eigenfrequency study (1 mode, the fundamental flexure near 1.2 MHz) with a thermoelastic_damping feature at T0 = 293.15 K, sweep of the conductivity k_beam over 130 (silicon) down to 1.6 W/(m K), which moves omega tau from 0.04 across the Debye peak to 3 at a fixed mode.
Analytic: the bending strain eps_xx = -y w'' heats the compressed side and cools the stretched one; the heat flows across the thickness (relaxation time tau = h^2 / (pi^2 D), D = k / (rho cp)) and the irreversible part costs 1 / Q = Delta omega tau / (1 + (omega tau)^2) (Zener), Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp) = 2.0e-4, peak 1 / Q = Delta / 2 (Q ~ 1e4) at omega tau = 1. The exact 1D heat-flow solution (Lifshitz-Roukes) 1 / Q = Delta (6 / xi^2 - 6 / xi^3 (sinh xi + sin xi) / (cosh xi + cos xi)), xi = h sqrt(omega / (2 D)), lies within 2 % of Zener. omega = the Euler-Bernoulli fundamental (pi / L)^2 sqrt(E h^2 / (12 rho)) (the computed one is 1e-4 off at L / h = 40). Library silicon itself (k = 130) sits far below the peak: Q_TED ~ 1.3e5.
Derived values tab: Qinv_ted against Lifshitz-Roukes (~0.1-0.5 %: Timoshenko shear energy ~(h / L)^2 and the bilinear temperature), Qinv_zener against Zener (~1-2 %), q_total_ted (= q_ted: no other loss) against 1 / Lifshitz-Roukes.
Sweep tab: 1 / Q_TED vs k_beam with the dashed Lifshitz-Roukes and Zener curves: the Debye peak. The parameters E_si .. alpha_si repeat the library silicon data for the references.
